title: Equations of motion (গতির সমীকরণ)
placement: Book pages 45–46, topic 2.7: গতির সমীকরণ (Equations of Motion). Next to the section text and its velocity–time graph with V = (u+v)/2.
description: The equations of motion (গতির সমীকরণ, pages 45–46, 2.7) with a commuter train on a straight double-track railway. The student sets its আদি বেগ u, ত্বরণ a (negative to brake; a braking train stops, it never goes backwards) and the time t with three steppers, and runs it in real time. The বেগ–সময় graph draws the straight line v = u + at while the area under it fills in 1-second strips, the same colours as the distance bar under the train: the area is the distance, and in equal seconds the distances are not equal. On the other track a see-through train runs the whole time at the average velocity V = (u + v)/2 and arrives at the same place at the same moment; at the end the triangle above V turns half round into the gap below it, so the trapezium becomes the rectangle V × t: s = Vt. The panel writes v = u + at, V = (u + v)/2, s = Vt, s = ut + ½at² and v² = u² + 2as with the student's numbers. Drag the train to see any moment. Test: 5 tap questions (the final velocity, the distance by the formula or from the graph's area, the average velocity or the velocity at half time, no acceleration, braking to a stop with v² = u² + 2as or v = u + at). Phone-first, Bangla. GLB: the railway and the two trains, in metres.
